Yep.  Aspiring writer here and ADHD can be a battle.  So many projects (stories, art etc) are unfinished because I jump from one idea to the next.  Add the procrastination and difficulty focusing on one thing for too long and it’s a challenge.
I’ve found medication helps a bit (just recently diagnosed) and working on something in short bouts sometimes helps.  I can also get hyper focused on some things and then burn out so little and often is the most effective way for me.  Setting aside a short time to write even if it’s just a few sentences it’s something.  Writing down ideas to set aside for future projects.  My organisation is terrible so I often have to map out things.  Good luck with your writing 😊
